title: Gluing: a current with a mass representation that agrees locally with integer multiplicity representations is integer multiplicity (IM is local)
statement: Assume (IMC)(a), passed as a hypothesis: the exact first conjunct of the frozen statement of cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub (hypothesis (IMC) of the selected node), namely: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and all Borel sets M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M and every linear subspace Q, Q is an approximate tangent space of M at x iff it is one of M' at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt). Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, X ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U k), μ a Borel measure on ℝ^P and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P k) such that μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, ξ is a.e. strongly measurable for μ, and X(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Suppose every x ∈ U lies in an open set W ⊆ U on which there is an IMRep R in W (IMRep W k) with μ⌞W = R.measure (the weight θ_R Hᵏ⌞M_R) and ξ(y) = R.orient(y) for μ-a.e. y ∈ W. Then X is integer multiplicity in U (IsIntegerMultiplicity X).
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P k), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, X ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ) → (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep W k), IsOpen W ∧ x ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ U ∧ μ.restrict W = R.measure ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, y ∈ W → ξ y = R.orient y) → IsIntegerMultiplicity X
